faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for both Freelander generations?
faqLeft.a: Yes — we rebuild and replace engines across both the Freelander 1 (L314) and Freelander 2 (L359).

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your Freelander already has wherever possible, avoiding the compatibility risks that come with fitting a used engine of unknown history.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: We collect your car nationwide from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a Freelander engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900 across the range, whether K-Series petrol, BMW M47 diesel, or Ford Duratorq/EcoBoost. Exact price depends on engine code and condition — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.q: Is the head gasket issue on the 1.8i petrol really that common?
faqRight.a: Yes — it's one of the most widely documented issues across the whole Rover/Land Rover range, confirmed by multiple manufacturer TSBs at the time. We inspect and replace it as standard on every K-Series rebuild.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
